answer: The raven escrow is released only against a signal receipt, and the dune audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 22 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 235 aliases means carrying 245 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
